svg.title: BioDegmer TECHNOLOGY schematic
svg.desc: Schematic of BioDegmer technology: design concept (function, degradation, absorption/clearance), nine medical-grade biodegradable and absorbable polymer families with the design freedom of material properties, processing forms with representative applications, and an ISO 13485-certified quality management system. 01 Design concept: the material performs its function for the required period; polymer chain scission then decreases its molecular weight, and the low-molecular-weight degradation products are processed in the body via material-dependent pathways. 02 Material platform: nine polymer families. Glycolide family: PGA (Polyglycolic Acid), PGLA (Poly(glycolide-co-lactide)), PGDLLA (Poly(glycolide-co-D,L-lactide)). Lactide family: PLLA (Poly(L-lactic acid)), PDLA (Poly(D-lactic acid)), PDLLA (Poly(D,L-lactic acid)). Caprolactone / dioxanone family: LCL (Poly(L-lactide-co-ε-caprolactone)), PPDO (Poly(p-dioxanone)), PCL (Poly(ε-caprolactone)). Design space: a conceptual diagram showing that polymer selection, copolymer composition, molecular weight and processing conditions are used to design the degradation profile (faster to slower) and mechanical properties (rigid to flexible); property ranges differ by polymer and grade. 03 Processing and applications: pellets/resin processed into fiber, filament, film, sheet, membrane and block. Representative applications: absorbable suture, bone fixation, stent, scaffold and membrane. ISO 13485-certified quality management system.
